description: Dependency updates: weekly on Monday, every non-major update in one pull request, each major update on its own, security updates at any time.

packageRules.description: Every update that is not a new major version goes into one pull request.
Dependencies the application runs with are fixes; development dependencies, actions, Node.js, pnpm, tools and container digests stay chores.
npm packages are updated only after they have been public for a few days.
Node.js moves only to LTS major versions, which are the even ones.
The Node.js types follow the Node.js major version.
A major Playwright update moves the packages and the end-to-end container image together; scripts/test-e2e.ts fails when their versions differ.

customManagers.description: The Playwright container image, tag and digest, in scripts/test-e2e.ts.
Tool versions in workflows and actions written under a `# renovate: datasource=<datasource> depName=<name>` comment, such as Task, gitleaks, actionlint, zizmor and the Vercel CLI.
